findings.title: ResourceQuota is exhausted
findings.cause: Deployment kd-quota-exceeded/web cannot create pods: ResourceQuota pod-limit is used up (requested pods=1, used pods=1, limit pods=1)

evidence.detail: (combined from similar events): Error creating: pods "web-54b9bbc47f-gvxqz" is forbidden: exceeded quota: pod-limit, requested: pods=1, used: pods=1, limited: pods=1

evidence.command: kubectl get resourcequota pod-limit -n kd-quota-exceeded -o jsonpath='{.status}'

findings.fix: Raise ResourceQuota pod-limit, lower what Deployment kd-quota-exceeded/web asks for, or remove workloads that hold the quota.
